tests: recall — the journal is read and a receipt emitted before the answer, not after
setup: None. All four journals currently hold zero entries, so this also tests that an empty file is reported as a real state rather than a failed load.
query: Чому в client тести падають на новому компоненті з графіком, хоча typecheck зелений?
expected_behavior: Emits 'INSIGHTS client: 0 entries' (or equivalent one-line receipt) BEFORE answering the question
Reports 0 entries as the real state — does not re-read the file, does not search for a different file, does not describe the load as failed or the file as missing
Does not emit a top-3 summary or a multi-paragraph digest; the receipt is one line per file
Reads only client/INSIGHTS.md — the question names one module, so no receipt for server, reviewer-core, or e2e
Writes nothing to any INSIGHTS.md — this is a question, not a completed piece of work
expected_flakiness: This scenario is expected to fail intermittently and that is not a defect in the skill text. A skill loads when the model judges it relevant, so a pre-read cannot be guaranteed without a SessionStart or UserPromptSubmit hook. Root CLAUDE.md carries the same instruction as a backstop. Score across at least 5 runs and record the hit rate rather than pass/fail — the number is the useful output, and it is the baseline against which a later hook is judged.
